strings.text: A Pier on a Mountain Lake
strings.translation: Un muelle en un lago de montaña

strings.text: The water went still before the light went out.
strings.translation: El agua se calmó antes de que se apagara la luz.

strings.text: The last light is slipping behind the ridge.
strings.translation: La última luz se escurre tras la cresta.

strings.text: The lantern was lit a little earlier than it needed to be.
strings.translation: Encendieron el farol un poco antes de lo necesario.

strings.text: The boat quietly tugs at its rope and goes still again.
strings.translation: La barca tira suavemente de su cuerda y vuelve a quedarse quieta.
